messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we had a ton of duplicate pages yesterday from the dedupe rule (A-14) after the deploy. Need clear owners and timelines for remediation. Who can take lead on tuning vs runbook updates?

maria: I can own threshold tuning and run the replay against last 7 days. Will validate false-positive rate before rolling.

jasper: I can take paging policy and dedupe logic review. I'll look at the rule that groups by fingerprint + source and check the clustering window.

oncall-bot: Incident summary: 2026-03-22T18:12Z — 27 duplicate pages in 12m, root cause: rule A-14 grouping widened after config change.

sam: I'll update the on-call runbook and add an immediate triage checklist. Also propose adding a 2-min suppression for identical-title alerts as a quick mitigation.

alex: Plan proposal (short):
1) Maria: run replay + propose new thresholds (ETA: 24h)
2) Jasper: audit grouping keys & clustering window + PR for stricter dedupe logic (ETA: 48h)
3) Sam: runbook update + add suppression mitigation and escalation notes (ETA: 12h)
4) Alex: coordinate canary rollout of new rule in prod for 6h window, roll back on any regressions (ETA: after Maria/Jasper PRs)

maria: To find replay set I'll use this query, should catch near-duplicates:
```sql
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) AS hits, min(ts) as first_seen, max(ts) as last_seen
FROM alerts
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING count(*) > 3
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

jasper: For clustering window I'm thinking 5m -> 1m test, and tighten grouping key to include region + job_id. Quick diff I'll open: `diff --git a/dedupe.yml b/dedupe.yml`

sam: I'll add the suppression step to the runbook like:
- If >10 duplicate pages in 10m, flip to suppression mode (2m) and notify infra-team.
- Run the replay query and tag samples for feedback.

alex: Good. Maria/jasper, please put PRs in the staging branch and tag me + @sam for runbook. We'll do the canary on Monday morning 06:00 PT (low traffic).

maria: Ack. I'll start the replay now and post findings in this thread.

jasper: Opening audit PR in ~2h. Will include perf tests to ensure dedupe change doesn't raise false negatives.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window Monday 06:00 PT.

alex: Once PRs are in, we run a 6h canary and monitor duplicate rate metric (`alerts.dedupe.duplicates_per_5m`). If reduced by >70% with <2% increase in missed-alerts, promote.

sam: I'll add a pager duty escalation note to runbook and mark the change as reversible in 10m.

maria: Replay quick result (initial): 14 fingerprints account for 62% of duplicates, most from the same job_id. Will paste a short CSV in a follow-up.

jasper: Nice — that means tightening grouping by job_id should cut most noise.

alex: Thanks team. Action owners: maria (threshold/replay), jasper (dedupe logic + PR), sam (runbook + suppression). I'll schedule the canary and post the rollout link here. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: starting now.

jasper: Will link PR: https://git.redwood/infra/dedupe/pull/134 when ready.

sam: Runbook PR coming in 3h.

alex: Closing loop — we'll reconvene after the canary finishes, or sooner if any regressions. Leave notes here.
